symbols.name: EEex_UncapFPS_SetVSyncEnabled

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Enables VSync if `true`; disables VSync if `false`.

symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary**
> Enables / disables VSync.

> **Warning**
> Calling this function during engine startup will crash the game.

**Parameters:**

| **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enabled | boolean |  | Enables VSync if `true`; disables VSync if `false`. |
